headline: Dr Mwinyi eyes to establish cheap airlinks to bolster Arusha-Zanzibar tourism
summary: Zanzibar President Hussein Ali Mwinyi said the government plans to set up an airline to increase competition, lower airfares and ease travel between Zanzibar and Arusha.
why: Air connectivity affects tourism revenue and trade flows, and a state-backed carrier would compete with existing airlines on regional routes.
